description: Calculates official EU customs duties (Common Customs Tariff / MFN) and import VAT for a given HS code and CIF customs value in EUR.

customs_value_eur.description: Customs CIF value in EUR (cost + insurance + freight to EU border)

hs_code.description: HS code or TARIC code (2, 4, 6 or 10 digits, e.g. 640411 or 6404110000)

origin_country.description: ISO-2 country code of export/origin (e.g. CN, US, VN). Default: third country (MFN rate)

name: calculate_customs_duties
